name: Phosphorus
role: Framework center of the PS4 3- thiophosphate tetrahedron (covalent backbone of Li6PS5Cl). Formally P5+, sp3-hybridized with 4 S. Redox-active on reduction (P5+ -> P -3, Li3P) and on condensation/oxidation (P2S7 4-, P2S6 4-, phosphate).

ionic_radius_A._note: Shannon 1976, tetrahedral (IV) P5+ = 0.17 A. In PS4 the P-S bond is strongly covalent (~2.0 A P-S), so 'ionic radius' is nominal.

representative_compounds.battery_role: covalent backbone tetrahedron of the argyrodite; hosts the Li+ cage
representative_compounds.note: P-S sigma network; free/non-bonding S carries the VBM. Anchor of the whole SE structure

representative_compounds.battery_role: binary thiophosphate SE end-member; PS4 3- building block of the Li2S-P2S5 family
representative_compounds.note: beta-Li3PS4 nanoporous SE; parent of argyrodite chemistry

representative_compounds.battery_role: terminal reduction product of PS4 vs Li metal (P -3); Li+-conductive interphase component
representative_compounds.note: Diagnostic P 2p3/2 collapse to ~125.4 eV; reached stepwise via LixP intermediates

representative_compounds.battery_role: condensed (P-S-P bridged / P-P bonded) thiophosphate units from thermal/oxidative evolution
representative_compounds.note: PS4 -> P2S7 -> P2S6 condensation raises thermal stability but P2S7 over-binds Li+ (suppresses conduction); Raman fingerprints below
P 2p3/2 ~133.3 eV; forms on oxidation and in O-doped (PS3O) chemistries; NdPO4-type P-O-Nd bridges in Nd2O3-doped variant

sei_relevance: P is the redox-active SEI former of the sulfide SE. PS4 3- is reduced at ~1.08 V vs Li/Li+ (Schwietert/Wagemaker grand-potential, via Bai 2020) to P / Li3P together with Li2S + LiCl. XPS shows the P 2p3/2 line move from ~131.7 eV (PS4/thiophosphate) DOWN to ~125.4 eV (terminal Li3P), passing through LixP intermediates — one of the clearest SEI-reduction diagnostics in argyrodites. On the oxidizing side, P shifts UP to ~133.3 eV (phosphate) and PS4 condenses to P2Sx. Li3P/Li2S/LiCl form the passivating interphase against Li metal.

xps.ref: Nat. Commun. 2025 (P role in argyrodite SEI); Liu 2022 gives 131.9 eV
Cha et al. 2024 (litdb); consistent with SEI XPS refs

xps.assignment: NOTE: P 2p is a spin-orbit doublet (2p3/2, 2p1/2 split ~0.85 eV); reduction proceeds PS4 -> LixP -> Li3P giving a broad low-BE tail

raman.assignment: PS4 3- symmetric stretch nu1 (argyrodite fingerprint; observed ~420-427 cm-1)
raman.ref: Wang et al., InfoMat 2022 (litdb); Lewis-acid-treated LPSCl 424->420-423

raman.assignment: PS4-related low-frequency mode (accompanies 425/577/600 cm-1 PS4 set)
raman.ref: Ke et al., Energy Storage Mater. 2025 (litdb)

dos_character: P-S forms the covalent sigma framework. The valence band top is dominated by S 3p (non-bonding/free S), with P 3s/3p contributing to deeper P-S bonding states; the conduction band minimum is PS4 antibonding (P 3s/3p x S 3p sigma*) with minor Li admixture. Thus P governs the CBM character and the framework's oxidative/reductive redox: removing electrons attacks S 3p (VBM), adding electrons populates PS4 sigma* (P-centered) leading to P-S cleavage and P reduction. O-for-S substitution (PS3O) deepens/reconfigures these states (S-p/p-p hybridization, Ke 2025).
